title: Ash-Sharh 94:7-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Ash-Sharh, Ad-Duha 1 to 8 and applying the rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 34 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ash-Sharh 94:7-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 34. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ (٧) وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Ikhfa': noon sakinah before ص; qalqalah on ب when stopping
Hum lightly; bounce the ب at the stop
Clear غ from the top of the throat
Do not turn غ into ق

keywords.def: a bounce on ق ط ب ج د with sukoon

questions.q: Chunk and link Ash-Sharh 94:7-8 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 94:7-8 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 94:7-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite the whole of Ash-Sharh to a partner.
Which two letters in 94:7 to 8 have qalqalah at the stop?
questions.a: The ب of «فَٱنصَبْ» and the ب of «فَٱرْغَب».

questions.q: What should we do when we finish a task (94:7 to 8)?
options: Stand for worship and turn to our Lord
questions.a: A) Stand for worship and turn to our Lord. 94:7 to 8.

questions.q: Think again: When you finish your homework, what is the best thing to do next?
questions.a: Turn to Allah: stand in worship and make du'a, as 94:7 to 8 teach.
